review.brief:
Review RM41 tier 4 (charging, ticket MAG-45): add a stored, auto-set three-state status column to charging.supercharger_sessions. Read the diff 3451e7d..HEAD, not the whole module. The artifacts commit is 3451e7d; implementation is e5ff412 and b231d6f; e5a01da and the final bookkeeping commit are records only.

VALIDATE:
1. Module boundary. charging-owned. TWO paths outside internal/charging/ were explicitly granted: the root README.md (task 4.2) and kkpa/context/use-case/charging/verify-session-battery.md (4.3). Confirm NOTHING else outside the module changed - in particular no internal/gateway/ or internal/telemetry/ file. Tier 5 renders the badge; this tier must not.
2. The migration 20260903000004_add_session_status.sql matches the design the OWNER CONFIRMED at the database gate: status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'IN_PROGRESS' with CHECK IN ('IN_PROGRESS','DONE_CALCULATED','DONE'), a SEPARATE unconditional UPDATE backfilling every row to DONE_CALCULATED (no WHERE, no CASE), a COMMENT ON COLUMN, a working Down, and NO index. A mismatch with the confirmed design is a blocker finding.
3. The backfill is DELIBERATE and owner-confirmed TWICE. All pre-existing rows become DONE_CALCULATED even though recomputing the derivation matches only 3 of 10, and 4 rows have a NULL energy_kwh so could never have been derived. The owner chose it on provenance the data cannot show (Tesla supplies no battery percentages, so every historic start was reconstructed). See decisions[].database-gate and the roadmap's roadmap:mag45-backfill. Do NOT report it as a bug.
4. sessionStatusFor implements the truth table exactly: either percentage nil -> IN_PROGRESS; both set and this write derived the start -> DONE_CALCULATED; both set and the start was caller-supplied -> DONE. Check the failed-derivation corner specifically: calculated = startToStore != nil, so a derivation returning nil must fall to IN_PROGRESS, never to a DONE state.
5. Only VerifySession writes status. Confirm MirrorSuperchargerSession's INSERT and ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE SET still exclude it (a mirrored session takes IN_PROGRESS from the column DEFAULT), and that its LOAD-BEARING guarding comment now says so. A status added to that SET clause is a blocker.
6. Test contract. The eight Group-S tests must assert the expectations design.md authored UP FRONT, not values read back from the implementation. Spot-check at least S4 (expects a derived start of 41 from a 30.5 kWh seed and a 90 percent end) and S8 (an out-of-range derivation expects nil and IN_PROGRESS). Judge test quality BY READING - do not run them.
7. No new unit-test files. The roadmap decision roadmap:tests is the owner's standing default: only the integration cases design.md authored, plus repairs to existing tests. 3.1 extends an existing file; flag any brand-new test file.
8. Docs. CLAUDE.md requires structural changes to update docs in the SAME change: charging/AGENTS.md, the root README.md and the kkpa/context/ KB. Note that the README's 'five human-verified battery-percentage columns' was PRE-EXISTING staleness from tiers 2-3, corrected here because this tier rewrites that sentence anyway (decisions[].artifacts:readme-staleness). Verify nothing else in kkpa/context/ still describes a 3-column SET clause or omits status.
9. Performance-Profile compliance (read-heavy): no index added, and design.md must justify that against the read patterns with a stated revisit trigger. Confirm no read path regressed and that status rides along on the existing SELECT * reads.
10. Anti-gaming: no acceptance criterion weakened or deleted, no self-approved status, no task marked done whose acceptance check fails from disk. Note that the worker reported a tasks.md 1.5 grep defect rather than editing it, and the leader confirmed the fix matched the file's existing field-group style - correct behavior, not a finding.

TEST-EXECUTION-POLICY (verbatim, project override in CLAUDE.md): 'Claude writes tests but never runs the suite - never go test ./..., make test, make test-with-db or make check. It MAY run go build ./..., go vet ./..., gofmt -l, make build, make vet, make bins, and the standalone guards make ui-guard / make i18n-guard / make money-guard / make tz-guard / make migration-guard / make boundary-guard. The owner runs the suite and reports results; work that is complete but unexecuted is awaiting-user-verification, never done, and a passing suite is recorded as the owner's report, never claimed by the assistant.'

SIGNAL PROVENANCE: assistant-run (leader) = go build ./... (0), go vet ./... (0), gofmt -l internal/charging (clean), make migration-guard (ok, only the pre-existing 20260720000001 warning), make boundary-guard (ok), openspec validate --strict (valid). USER-REPORTED = make migrate-up, the status count check returning 10 rows all DONE_CALCULATED, and the suite - run TWICE by the owner: once after wave 1+2 (before the status tests existed) and again after wave 3+4, which is the run that exercises them. Both passed. You may re-run only the assistant-permitted signals; never the suite.

KNOWN, OUT OF SCOPE: gofmt -l flags 7 files repo-wide (account x2, config x1, gateway x4). All pre-existing; this change touched no file outside internal/charging/, which is clean. Do not report them.
